package server

import (
	_ "embed"
	"testing"

	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Endpoint() Data {
	return Data{}
}

type Data struct{}

func (Data) Number() int32 { return 7 }

func (Data) Square(n int64) int64 { return int64(n * n) }
